jobs.title: Secure Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Unlock the power of Safety and Mission Critical Engineering with QDSS. We are seeking exceptional individuals to join our elite team- where your expertise will make an impact that matters. Elevate your career in a company dedicated to excellence and the pursuit of safety and mission success.

Quest Defense Systems & Solutions is seeking a Secure Embedded Software Engineer with hands-on Rust experience to develop low-level software for advanced aerospace and defense systems. You’ll design, implement, test, and integrate secure embedded software supporting board support packages, hardware interfaces, and FPGA-based platforms.

This is an opportunity to join upcoming programs at an early stage, influence the software architecture, and work closely with systems, hardware, and FPGA engineers. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys memory-safe systems programming, hardware-near development, and solving complex challenges within secure, mission-critical environments.

This position is onsite based in El Segundo, CA. Relocation assistance is available.

U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain a Secret clearance are required. Active Secret clearance is preferred.

What You’ll Do

Design, develop, and maintain secure embedded software using Rust.
Develop low-level board support packages, device drivers, and hardware interface software.
Integrate software with FPGAs, SoCs, processors, and other embedded hardware components.
Participate in software requirements, architecture, interface definition, and technical trade studies.
Apply secure software design and coding practices throughout the development lifecycle.
Develop and execute unit, integration, and system-level tests.
Support board bring-up, hardware/software integration, debugging, and performance optimization.
Troubleshoot complex issues across software, hardware, FPGA, and system boundaries.
Collaborate with systems, hardware, FPGA, cybersecurity, and test engineering teams.
Conduct code reviews and produce design documentation, test evidence, and other technical artifacts.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
At least five years of embedded software development experience.
Hands-on software development experience using Rust.
Experience developing board support packages, device drivers, hardware abstraction layers, or other hardware-interface software.
Strong understanding of embedded systems, memory management, concurrency, and real-time software concepts.
Experience integrating software with processors, SoCs, FPGAs, or other embedded hardware.
Experience with software requirements, architecture, unit testing, integration testing, debugging, and code reviews.
Understanding of secure software design and coding practices.
Experience using version control and modern software-development tools.
Ability to work onsite in El Segundo, CA.
U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

Active Secret security clearance.
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Production experience using Rust for embedded, bare-metal, or other resource-constrained systems.
Experience with C or C++ and integrating Rust with existing low-level software.
Experience developing BSPs or device drivers for an RTOS or embedded Linux environment.
Familiarity with FPGA-based platforms and SoC hardware/software integration.
Previous experience developing software for aerospace, defense, or other high-assurance systems.
Knowledge of DO-178C or similar safety-critical software development processes.
Experience with static analysis, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, or secure development tools.
Experience supporting classified programs or secure development environments.
Experience adopting and/or integrating emerging technologies (e.g., generative AI, automation platforms, digital assistants) into day-to-day operations for continuous improvement.

The QDSS Advantage:

At QDSS, our advantage is purpose-driven work, collaborative teams, and complex challenges that push boundaries and build lasting impact. You’ll grow your career while contributing to mission-critical programs that demand excellence and shape the future.

What You’ll Find Here

Work That Matters – Next-generation, safety- and mission-critical projects where your contributions have real-world impact.
Growth That’s Supported – Competitive compensation, employer-matched 401(k), certification assistance, and clear opportunities for advancement.
A Culture That Works – A flexible, collaborative, and people-first environment where teamwork, innovation, and balance are valued.

Benefits Include

Competitive pay, comprehensive medical/dental/life and disability coverage, 401(k) with employer match, professional development support, and a flexible, friendly workplace.

CoAspire
is a cutting-edge defense manufacturing leader in Northern Virginia, specializing in the precision assembly of advanced weapons systems. With over thirteen years of a legacy of innovation, we're at the forefront of building reliable, affordable mass weapons that protect and empower our nation’s warfighters. Our tight-knit team thrives in a collaborative environment where safety, quality, and work-life balance come first with a focus on professional growth at our new 27,000+ sq. ft. facility. Join us to make a tangible impact on mission-critical technology while enjoying Northern Virginia's vibrant community.

What you will do:

You will contribute to the design, development, integration, and test of embedded and application software for advanced missile programs. This cross-functional role involves close collaboration with systems engineering, electrical/hardware design, guidance, and test teams to deliver reliable, real-time software solutions. There are multiple needs: supporting embedded operational flight program (OFP) efforts, creating test and automation software (primarily on Windows platforms), implementing specialized flight algorithms, and supporting integration and qualification testing — all while ensuring compliance with performance, safety, security, and (near) real-time requirements.

Location
: Manassas, VA

Responsibilities:

Support the design, development, modification, and review of embedded software in C/C++ for missile flight control and supporting subsystems.
Develop test programs, automation scripts, and graphical user interfaces (GUIs), primarily on Windows platforms, to support software-in-the-loop (SIL), hardware-in-the-loop (HWIL), integration, and qualification testing.
Implement, optimize, and verify guidance, control, and signal-processing algorithms.
Support software-hardware integration, including debugging, interface definition, and real-time performance analysis.
Conduct unit and system testing, end-to-end integration testing, code reviews, and support system-level verification and flight-worthiness testing.
Perform root-cause analysis on software issues, implement fixes, and support configuration management and change processes.
Generate and maintain software documentation (in line with Model Based System Engineering (MBSE) expectations), including requirements specifications, design descriptions, test plans, and reports.
Ensure all software complies with customer-required guidelines, coding standards and security requirements.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
1-5 years of software engineering experience in aerospace/defense or related field.
Proficiency in C/C++ for embedded or real-time applications.
Experience with embedded software development, debugging tools, and version control (e.g., Git, GitHub, Kanban-based agile development).
Familiarity with real-time systems, multithreading, and basic software-hardware interfacing.
U.S. citizenship and current Secret clearance (or ability to obtain and maintain one).
Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with TypeScript/JavaScript for test application and GUI development.
Experience with Windows-based test environments, automation frameworks, or lab integration tools.
Familiarity with Cameo for MBSE efforts.

Beyond competitive pay, we offer:
Full benefits beginning first of month following hire: medical, dental and vision
401(k) with generous company match and immediate vesting
PTO and Federal holidays

About the Company

We are HCLTech, one of the fastest-growing large tech companies in the world and home to 230,000+ people across 60 countries, supercharging progress through industry-leading capabilities centered around Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

About the Role

We are building a browser-based 3D virtual science lab. Students assemble apparatus, perform experiments, and are assessed on their technique — all rendered in real time with React 19, React Three Fiber (Three.js), and Zustand, built with Vite. The simulation runs on ordinary school hardware, including low-end Chromebooks, so it has to be both convincing and fast, and its behavior has to be deterministic enough to score reliably.
A defining characteristic of how we work: much of this product is built with AI coding agents (Claude Code) across a multi-worktree setup, directed by engineers who scope the work, review every change critically, and encode our conventions so the agents stay on the rails. We are looking for a senior front-end engineer who is excellent at the fundamentals and genuinely effective at directing AI agents — not one or the other.
What you'll do

Build and own complex React Three Fiber features: interactive 3D equipment, a selection-driven action system, real-time visual effects, and the UI around them.
Keep the app fast on low-end hardware — profile and tune the render loop, manage GPU/CPU cost, and hold a frame budget on Chromebook-class devices.
Keep application state coherent as it grows (simulation state, equipment state, an event log used for assessment, and UI state) using Zustand.
Make accessibility real: full keyboard operation, focus management, ARIA, and screen-reader support are core requirements here, not polish.
Direct Claude Code effectively — decompose work into well-specified, agent-sized tasks, review the output with a senior eye, and know when to write something by hand instead.
Help maintain the conventions, CLAUDE.md guidance, and repo structure that keep AI-generated code consistent and safe.
Collaborate with our 3D technical artist to integrate assets and shaders cleanly.

Required skills and experience

Front-end engineering (the foundation — non-negotiable):

Deep, senior-level React
(React 19 / modern React): the render model, hooks discipline, memoization, effect timing, and a real feel for where re-renders and stale closures come from — which matter acutely in an app running a physics loop every frame.
Three.js and React Three Fiber in production.

Implement, optimize, and verify guidance, control, and signal-processing algorithms.

Conduct unit and system testing, end-to-end integration testing, code reviews, and support system-level verification and flight-worthiness testing.

Generate and maintain software documentation (in line with Model Based System Engineering (MBSE) expectations), including requirements specifications, design descriptions, test plans, and reports.

Build and own complex React Three Fiber features: interactive 3D equipment, a selection-driven action system, real-time visual effects, and the UI around them.
